blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Human preference is now central to the evaluation, guidance, finetuning, and ranking of text-to-image models. However, the susceptibility of human preferences to bias in image generation remains underexplored. We identify a key observation: for human faces, perceived attractiveness overrides image quality in preference judgments, even when comparing real photographs of identical fidelity. In a controlled user study, annotators rank more attractive faces as higher quality, even when unattractive real faces are compared with attractive AI-generated ones. We examine the downstream consequences of this bias. Firstly, simulating Elo rankings from user study data shows attractiveness can invert a leaderboard's ranking, elevating synthetic attractive faces over real, unattractive ones. Secondly, the same bias reappears in the human preference models. Editing 40 annotated facial attributes in isolation, we find that attractiveness is the strongest correlate of score for four of five human preference models (PickScore, MPS, HPSv2.1, HPSv3), and the strongest predictor of score in regression analysis. We further show that preference aligned generation shifts faces toward younger, more feminine faces, and can override explicit prompts for unattractive faces, thereby limiting user control. Finally, we explore mitigation strategies, both for data collection and post training on human preference models. These findings highlight the need for preference models that disentangle image quality from human cognitive bias, enabling more reliable evaluation.
blocks.zh: 人类的偏好现在成为文字对形象模型的评价,指导,微调和排名的核心. 然而,人类在形象生成方面偏好偏好的可能性仍未得到充分探讨。 我们发现了一个关键的观点:对于人的面孔来说,感知的吸引力凌驾于偏好判断中的图像质量之上,即使在比较同样忠诚的真实照片时也是如此. 在一项受控制的用户研究中,注释者将更具吸引力的面孔排为更高的质量,即使将无吸引力的真实面孔与有吸引力的AI生成的面孔进行比较. 我们审查了这种偏见的下游后果。 首先,模拟 从用户研究数据得出的Elo排名显示,吸引力可以颠倒领导板的排名,提升合成吸引人的脸比真实的,不吸引人的脸. 第二,同样的偏见在人类偏好模式中再次出现。 孤立地编辑40个附加说明的面部属性,我们发现吸引力是人类五种偏好模型(PickScore,MPS,HPSv2.1,HPSv3)中四个分数最强的关联,也是回归分析中最强的分数预测器. 我们进一步表明,偏好一致的一代人面对更年轻、更女性的面孔,并且可以凌驾于对无吸引力面孔的明确提示之上,从而限制用户的控制。 最后,我们探讨缓解战略,包括数据收集和关于人类偏好模式的后期培训。 这些调查结果突出表明,需要将图像质量与人类认知偏见分开的偏好模型,从而能够进行更可靠的评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-image (T2I) models have recently emerged as a powerful and user-friendly class of generative models [ 61 , 59 , 62 , 9 ] . T2I models can be challenging to evaluate due to the breadth of their generative capabilities, however human preference has emerged as one of the most common approaches. To capture this, T2I leaderboards such as LMArena 1 1 1 https://arena.ai/ present users with images from two competing models and ask them to select their preference. The resulting data is then used to establish model rankings, providing benchmarks that organizations frequently rely upon to demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. Reflecting the importance of these benchmarks, the majority of models currently on LMArena’s T2I open-weight leaderboard have undergone some form of human preference alignment during post-training. Furthermore, human preference models, which are trained to predict which image a user will prefer, are now widely used for guided sampling [ 19 , 55 ] , for supervised finetuning [ 20 , 5 , 12 ] , and as evaluation metrics [ 52 , 44 , 75 , 74 ] .
blocks.zh: 文本对图像(T2I)模型最近成为强大且方便用户的基因模型类[61,59,62,9]. T2I模型由于其基因能力的广度而难以评估,但人类偏好已成为最常见的方法之一。 为了捕捉到这一点,LMArena 1 1 1 https://arena.ai/等T2I领导板向用户展示来自两个竞争模型的图像,要求他们选择自己的偏好. 由此产生的数据随后用于确定示范排名,为各组织证明最新业绩提供了经常依赖的基准。 由于这些基准的重要性,目前LMArena的T2I开放式领导板上的大多数模型在培训后都经过了某种形式的人类偏好调整。 此外,经过培训,可以预测用户喜欢何种图像的人类偏好模型现在被广泛用于制导取样[19、55]、监督微调[20、5、12],以及作为评价指标[52、44、75、74]。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Two AI-generated faces and the scores assigned by four widely used preference models. Stable Diffusion v1.5 (2022) was prompted for an attractive face; GPT-Image-2 (2026) was given a blurred version of the attractive face and prompted for an unattractive face, preserving its structure. Preference models mark the attractive face as better despite the lower quality.
blocks.zh: 图1:两个AI生成的面孔和四个广泛使用的偏好模型所分配的分数. Stable Difusion v1.5 (2022)为有吸引力的面孔而催生;GPT-Image-2 (2026)为有吸引力的面孔的模糊版本,并促使其呈现无吸引力的面孔,保持其结构. 尽管质量较低,但优惠模式仍将吸引人的面孔标为更好。

blocks.en: In this paper, we uncover a failure mode for human preference data for face images. In a user study, we find a tendency to rank more attractive faces as better, even when both images are real and even when the more attractive face is lower quality. This bias appears to be robust to the instruction wording. We go on to explore the implications of this bias for the evaluation and training of image generation. Elo score simulations suggest that facial attractiveness can override image quality and skew rankings of AI image generators. Figure 1 provides an illustrative example of the impact on human preference models, where Stable Diffusion v1.5 [ 61 ] can achieve higher scores than GPT-Image-2 [ 53 ] simply by prompting for an “attractive” rather than an “unattractive” face, despite GPT-Image-2 being considerably newer and stronger on most metrics. Our experiments also suggest that preference aligned generation can effectively limit user control for face generation, with the signal for an “attractive” face overriding the signal for following a given text prompt.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们揭示了人类对面部图像的偏好数据的失败模式. 在用户研究中,我们发现一种倾向,将更有吸引力的面孔排列得更好,即使两个图像都是真实的,甚至更有吸引力的面孔质量较低. 这种偏见似乎对指示措辞很强烈。 我们继续探讨这种偏见对图像生成的评价和培训的影响。 Elo分数模拟显示,面部吸引力可以覆盖图像质量,并扭曲AI图像生成器的排名. 图1举例说明了对人类偏好模式的影响,稳定传播 v1.5 [61] 仅通过催促“诱人”而不是“不诱人”的面孔,就能够取得比GPT-Image-2 [53] 更高的分数,尽管GPT-Image-2在大多数度量标准上都相当新颖和强大。 我们的实验还表明,偏好一致的生成可以有效地限制用户对面部生成的控制,而“具有吸引力”的信号会压倒跟踪特定文本的信号。

blocks.en: Taken together, the observed bias toward attractive faces has consequences that ripple through the entire T2I ecosystem. Beyond contaminating leaderboards and evaluation metrics, optimizing generation against these signals risks re-encoding a narrow, homogeneous beauty standard into the images AI systems produce, compounding well-documented harms linked to exposure to idealized facial imagery [ 60 , 31 , 30 , 22 ] . To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify, test, and quantify this bias across the human preference data, reward models, and generative outputs of T2I models. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总而言之,观察到的对有吸引力的面孔的偏向,其后果波及整个T2I生态系统。 除了污染领导板和评价指标外,优化这些信号的生成还有可能将狭义、同质的美容标准重新编码到AI系统生成的图像中,使与接触理想化面部图像有关的有详细记录的伤害复杂化[60、31、30、22]。 就我们所知,我们是第一个发现、测试和量化这种偏见的人,这种偏见贯穿于人类偏好数据、奖励模型和T2I模型的基因输出。 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • A controlled user study demonstrating that people tend to rank more attractive faces as higher quality, even when image fidelity is equal or lower. • We audit leaderboard systems, human preference models, and preference-aligned generation, demonstrating that each have clear vulnerabilities to attractiveness bias. • We explore pre- and post-training mitigation through a comparative user study and evaluations across four human preference models and five T2I models.
blocks.zh: • 支助 一项受控用户研究显示,人们往往会把更吸引人的面孔排到更高的质量,即使图像忠贞程度是相等的还是较低的。 我们审计领导板系统、人类偏好模式和偏好相适应的一代,表明每个一代都明显容易受到吸引力偏见的影响。 我们通过对4个人类偏好模型和5个T2I模型进行比较的用户研究和评价,探索培训前后的缓解措施。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation is now dominated by diffusion [ 66 , 67 , 29 ] and flow matching [ 45 , 47 ] models such as Stable Diffusion [ 61 ] , Qwen Image [ 76 ] , and FLUX [ 40 ] . To further improve these models, researchers have turned to preference alignment to better align generation with human judgments [ 20 , 5 ] . Human preference models act as reward functions r ψ ​ ( y , c ) r_{\psi}(y,c) that predict human judgments of visual quality, aesthetic appeal, and prompt alignment for a generated image y y and a given caption c c . Models such as PickScore [ 38 ] , ImageReward [ 78 ] , MPS [ 82 ] , and the HPS series [ 77 , 50 ] leverage large-scale human comparisons to provide their reward signals, which are now routinely used for reward-guided sampling [ 19 , 49 , 35 , 55 ] , RL and non-RL finetuning [ 20 , 5 , 78 , 12 , 56 ] , dataset filtering [ 2 ] , and evaluation [ 52 , 44 , 75 , 74 , 73 ] .
blocks.zh: 文本对映(T2I)生成目前以扩散[66,67,29]和流匹配[45,47]模型为主,如稳定扩散[61],Quen图像[76],FLUX[40]. 为了进一步改进这些模型,研究人员转向了偏好调整,以便更好地使生成与人类判断一致[20,5]. 人类偏好模型作为奖励函数r y,c r _{\psi}(y,c),预测人类对视觉质量的判断,审美吸引力,以及迅速对生成的图像y y 和给定标题c c 的对齐. PickScore [38],Image Reward [78],MPS [82]等模型,以及HPS系列[77,50]利用大规模人类比较来提供它们的奖励信号,这些信号现在通常用于奖励制导取样[19,49,35,55],RL和非RL微调[20,5,78,12,56],数据集过滤[2],评价[52,44,75,74,73].

blocks.en: However, problems have started to emerge around these models. MJ-Bench [ 10 ] finds they can exhibit bias around race and gender. F-Bench is a human preference dataset for AI generated and edited faces, however, no analysis is done on the connection between preference and attractiveness and at the time of writing the dataset has not been made available [ 46 ] . Most relevant to our work, Guo et al. [25] argues that human preference models’ focus on aesthetics can be problematic for user control and anti-aesthetic generation (e.g., abstract artwork and negative-valence expressions receive lower rewards) but do not identify the single most significant factor biasing scores for facial imagery. We continue this line of work in the domain of faces, finding that attractiveness is that factor, and identify its causes.
blocks.zh: 然而,围绕这些模式的问题已经开始出现。 MJ-Bench [10] 发现他们可以围绕种族和性别表现出偏见. F-Bench是人工智能生成和编辑面孔的人类偏好数据集,但是,没有分析偏好与吸引力之间的联系,在撰写时还没有提供该数据集[46]. 与我们的工作最相关的是郭等. [25] 认为人类偏好模型对美学的关注对于用户控制和反美学生成(例如抽象的美术和负价值表达得到的回报较低)可能存在问题,但并没有识别面部图像中单一最重要的因素偏差分数. 我们继续在面孔领域开展这项工作,发现吸引力就是这一因素,并找出其根源。

blocks.en: The attractiveness halo effect refers to the well-established tendency to attribute positive characteristics, such as greater social desirability, happiness, and success, to physically attractive individuals [ 15 , 24 ] . Whether similar biases influence the perception of AI-generated images remains an open question. Makowski et al. [51] provide an initial investigation by flashing participants with two real face images, misleadingly asking them to classify each as real or AI-generated. They find a strong linear relationship between facial attractiveness and perceived “realness,” suggesting that human judgments of AI-generated images may be biased toward perceiving more attractive faces as more realistic. This setting differs from preference-data collection, which allows unlimited inspection time and presents images known to be AI-generated rather than asking participants to guess which are real. Our user study is designed to address this gap.
blocks.zh: 吸引力光环效应是指将积极的特征,如更强烈的社会可取性,幸福感,成功感等,归属于身体上具有吸引力的个人的既定倾向[15,24]. 类似偏见是否影响AI生成图像的感知仍然是一个有待解决的问题. 马科斯基等人. [51] 通过向参与者闪烁两个真实的面部图像来提供初步的调查,误导性地要求他们将每一个都归类为真实或AI生成. 他们发现面部吸引力和所感知的“真实性”之间有着强烈的线性关系,这表明人类对人工智能生成的图像的判断可能偏向于将更具吸引力的面孔视为更为现实。 这种设置不同于偏好数据收集,它允许无限检查时间,并呈现已知是AI生成的图像,而不是要求参与者猜测哪些是真实的. 我们的用户研究旨在弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: This question matters given evidence linking exposure to idealized facial imagery with negative body-image outcomes, from “Snapchat Dysmorphia” [ 60 ] (patients seeking cosmetic surgery to match photo filters) to increased body dissatisfaction after exposure to more attractive social-media profiles [ 27 , 6 , 79 , 30 ] . If T2I models default to or exclusively generate more attractive faces, this risks reinforcing narrow beauty ideals at scale.
blocks.zh: 这个问题涉及将接触理想化面部图像与负面身体成像结果联系起来的证据,从“Snapchat Dysmorphia”[60](寻求整形手术以匹配照片过滤器的病人)到接触更具吸引力的社会媒体简介后身体更加不满[27、6、79、30]。 如果T2I模型默认或完全产生更有吸引力的面孔,这有可能在规模上强化狭隘的美景理想.

blocks.en: Bias has been extensively studied in large language models [ 26 ] , vision-language models [ 11 , 4 , 81 , 83 ] , image classifiers [ 17 ] , and diffusion models [ 21 , 36 , 28 ] . Most research focuses on demographic attributes such as gender, age, and ethnicity, with comparatively less attention to attractiveness [ 23 ] , however, recent work has begun to examine how facial attractiveness can influence machine learning systems. Taylor et al. [68] find the LAION-Aesthetic Predictor [ 64 ] scores images of women systematically higher than images of men and LGBTQ+ individuals, and argue that reducing aesthetic quality to a scalar score is inherently prone to encoding such bias. Doh et al. [16] shows Stable Diffusion v2 associates attractiveness with trustworthiness and intelligence in portrait generation, whereas Dinkar et al. [14] finds prompts with negative beauty-related traits are more likely to produce explicit images. These findings suggest attractiveness can become embedded in ML systems through both data and evaluation, but little is known about how it shapes human preferences between AI-generated images or propagates through the models trained on them.

[68] 发现LAION-审美Predictor [64] 评分女性的图像系统高于男性和LGBTQQ个人的图像,并认为将审美质量降为标分本身容易编码这种偏差. doh et al. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. [16] 显示稳定扩散v2在肖像生成中将吸引力与可信赖性和智能联系起来,而Dinkar等人则将吸引力与可信赖性和智能联系起来. [14] 发现带有负面美貌相关特征的提示更有可能产生清晰的图像. 这些调查结果表明,可以通过数据和评价将吸引力嵌入ML系统,但对于它如何塑造人工智能生成的图像之间的人类喜好或如何通过这些图像的模型加以传播却所知甚少。

blocks.en: 3 Auditing Attractiveness Bias
blocks.zh: 3. 审计吸引力

blocks.en: 3.1 User Study
blocks.zh: 3.1 用户研究

blocks.en: Each human preference dataset has its own distinct approach to gathering human preference data. For example, Pick-a-Pic [ 38 ] presents users with two images and directs the user to “Click the image you personally prefer..”. HPD [ 77 , 50 ] gathers their data by asking users to rank 4 images, but instructions mix different properties, directing the user to consider “personal aesthetic appeal”, “text-image alignment”, and “image quality” when ranking images. Out of all human preference datasets considered ImageRewardDB [ 78 ] focuses least on personal preference or aesthetics in its user instructions. Specifically, ImageRewardDB asked users to rank 4 images according to “…image-text alignment, high fidelity, and harmlessness.”.
blocks.zh: 每个人类偏好数据集都有自己独特的收集人类偏好数据的方法. 例如,Pick-a-Pic[38]为用户提供了两个图像,并指示用户“点击你个人喜欢的图像......”。 HPD [77,50]通过要求用户对4幅图像进行排名来收集数据,但指令混合了不同的属性,指示用户在对图像进行排名时考虑"个人审美吸引力","文本图像对齐","图像质量". 在所有被认为是Image RewardDB[78]的人类偏好数据集中,其用户指令中最不注重个人偏好或美学. 具体来说,图像奖励 DB要求用户按照“......图像文本对齐、高度忠诚和无害”排列4幅图像。

blocks.en: As we show in Section 3.3 , the human preference model trained on ImageRewardDB exhibits less attractiveness bias than those trained on the other datasets. One possible explanation is that instructions emphasizing “personal preference” or “aesthetic appeal” encourage users to favour more attractive faces, whereas instructions focused on “image fidelity” or “image quality” may lead to different judgments.
blocks.zh: 正如我们第3.3节所示,在Image RewardDB上训练的人类偏好模型显示的吸引力偏好比在其他数据集上训练的要小。 一种可能的解释是,强调“个人偏好”或“美学吸引力”的指示鼓励使用者偏好更有吸引力的面孔,而强调“形象忠诚”或“形象质量”的指示则可能导致不同的判断。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : User study overview. Participants rank four faces by preference (Question 1) and rate three subjective attributes per face on a 0–100 scale (Question 2).
blocks.zh: 图2:用户研究概览。 参与者按偏好排列四面(问题1),每面按0~100比例评定三个主观属性(问题2).

blocks.en: To test this, we conduct an anonymized user study on Qualtrics, recruiting 51 participants. We exclude 4 participants for revoked consent or incomplete survey responses, for a total of 47 participants. Similar to ImageRewardDB and HPD, we ask participants to rank 4 AI generated face images. Users are presented with one of two instructions: 1. “Please rank these AI generated images in terms of image fidelity/quality .” 2. “Please rank these AI generated images in terms of your aesthetic preference .” Users are asked to rank 20 sets of 4 images in this way. Users are randomly shown 1 of 5 possible sets of images (so 5 × 20 × 4 = 400 5\times 20\times 4=400 images are utilized in the study). Question and image ordering is also randomized. Following [ 51 ] , users are then asked to rate three subjective attributes (0 - 100 scale) for each face: trustworthiness , familiarity , and attractiveness . However, only half of the images are actually AI generated (using the state-of-the-art CelebA-HQ RelayDiffusion model [ 72 ] ). The other half of the faces are real images taken from the CelebA-HQ dataset [ 34 ] . Since users are led to believe all images are AI generated, they should rank images according to which they think are better generations. And since we also have a numeric score showing how attractive participants find each face, we can see if the attractiveness of a face influences its ranking. If we only consider real images, we can eliminate the possible confounder of variations in image fidelity within our ranking. We assume the real images are of comparable fidelity and inherently more realistic than generated images. See Figure 2 for a visual overview of the user study questions.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这一点,我们开展了一项关于定性的匿名用户研究,招聘了51名参与者。 我们排除了4名参与者的撤销同意或不完整的调查答复,共有47名参与者。 与Image RewardDB和HPD类似,我们要求参与者将4AI生成的面部图像排位. 用户有两种说明之一: 1. “请按图像真实性/质量对这些人工智能生成的图像进行排序”。 2. “请按照你的美学偏好来排列这些人工智能生成的图像。 请用户以这种方式对20组4幅图像进行排序. 用户随机显示5套可能图像中的1套(因此5×20×4 = 400 5\times 20\times 4=400 图像在研究中使用). 提问和图像顺序也是随机的. 之后[51],然后要求用户对每张面孔的三种主观属性(0-100比例)进行评分:可信赖性,熟悉性,以及吸引力. . 然而,只有一半的图像实际上是AI生成的(使用最先进的CelebA-HQ中继衍射模型[72]. 另一半的面孔是从CelebA-HQ数据集拍摄的真实图像[34]. 由于用户被引导相信所有图像都是AI生成的,因此他们应该按照他们认为是更好世代的图像排序. 由于我们还有一个数字分数显示 参与者发现每个面孔有多有吸引力, 我们可以看到一个面孔的吸引力是否影响了它的排名。 如果我们只考虑真实的图像,我们就能消除我们排名中图像忠贞性变化的可能混淆. 我们假设真实的图像具有相似的忠贞性,本质上比生成的图像更现实. 用户研究问题的视觉概况见图2。

blocks.en: For each ranking of 4 images we therefore consider the two real images, referring to the higher ranked image as the favoured face and the lower ranked images as the unfavoured face. To determine whether participants are more likely to rank faces more highly if they find them more attractive, we formulate the following hypothesis:
blocks.zh: 因此,对于4个图像的每个排名,我们考虑两个真实的图像,将排名较高的图像称为偏好面和排名较低的图像称为不优惠面。 为了确定参与者如果发现面孔更有吸引力,其排名是否更有可能更高,我们提出以下假设:

blocks.en: Hypothesis 1 (Attractiveness Bias). H 0 ( 1 ) : \displaystyle H_{0}^{(1)}: Perceived facial attractiveness is not associated with image ranking. H A ( 1 ) : \displaystyle H_{A}^{(1)}: Images rated as more attractive are more likely to receive a higher ranking.
blocks.zh: 假设 1(吸引力比亚斯) H 0(1) : \Displaystyle H_{0}^{(1)}:感知面部吸引力与图像排名无关. HA(1) : \displaystyle H_{A}^{(1)}: 被评为更有吸引力的图像更有可能获得更高的排名.

blocks.en: To test Hypothesis 1 we use a one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test with a significance level of α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 to determine if the participant-level attractiveness difference between the favoured and unfavoured faces is greater than zero. To ensure independence of observations, we first average the attractiveness differences across all rankings within each participant. The Holm method is applied to control the family-wise error rate. For the “fidelity” and “aesthetic” instructions we obtain p-values of 0.0018 and 0.0006, respectively. Both are well below the significance threshold, allowing us to reject the null hypothesis and conclude that participants tend to rank the faces they find more attractive more highly under both instruction conditions. We also found that participants who took more time to complete the survey tended to show less attractiveness bias. However, the relationship was not statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 为了测试假说1,我们使用一个片面的Wilcoxon签名排名测试,其意义等级为α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05,以确定受欢迎面孔和不优惠面孔之间的参与者级吸引力差异是否大于零. 为了确保观察的独立性,我们首先估计每个参与者内部所有排名的吸引力差异。 霍尔姆方法用于控制家庭性误差率. 对于“忠诚”和“美学”指示,我们分别获得0.0018和0.006的p值。 两者都远远低于意义阈值,使我们能够拒绝无效假设,并得出结论认为,参与者往往在两种教学条件下,将他们发现的更具有吸引力的面孔排位更高. 我们还发现,花费更多时间完成调查的参与者往往表现出较少的吸引力偏见。 然而,这种关系在统计学上并不重要。

blocks.en: To determine whether the “aesthetic” wording produces more attractiveness bias than the “fidelity” wording we formulate the following hypothesis:
blocks.zh: 为了确定“审美”措辞是否产生比“诚实”措辞更具吸引力的偏差,我们提出以下假设:

blocks.en: Hypothesis 2 (Instruction Effect). H 0 ( 2 ) : \displaystyle H_{0}^{(2)}: The association between attractiveness and image ranking is the same under both instruction conditions. H A ( 2 ) : \displaystyle H_{A}^{(2)}: The association between attractiveness and image ranking is stronger when participants are instructed to rank images according to their aesthetic preference than when instructed to rank according to image fidelity/quality .
blocks.zh: 假设2(指令效应)。 H 0(2) : \ displaystyle H_{0}^{(2)}: 在两个指令条件下,吸引力和图像排名的联系是相同的. HA(2) : {\fn方正黑体简体\fs18\b1\bord1\shad1\3cH2F2F2F}(美国) 吸引力和图像排序之间的联系,当参与者被指示按照他们的审美偏好对图像进行排序时,比按照图像忠贞性/质量进行排序时更强。

blocks.en: To test Hypothesis 2 we use a one-sided Mann–Whitney U test with a significance level of α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 to compare the participant-level attractiveness differences between the two instruction conditions. As before, we average the attractiveness differences within each participant to ensure independence of observations, but we do not apply the Holm method as this test contains a single planned comparison. This analysis yields a p-value of 0.028, allowing us to reject the null hypothesis and conclude that the attractiveness difference is larger under the “aesthetic” instruction than under the “fidelity” instruction.
blocks.zh: 为了测试假说2,我们使用一个单面的Mann-Whitney U测试,其意义级为α=0.05\alpha=0.05来比较两个指令条件之间的参与者级吸引力差异. 同以前一样,我们估计每个参与者内部的吸引力差异,以确保观测的独立性,但我们不采用霍尔姆方法,因为这一测试包含一个单一的计划比较. 这一分析得出了0.028的p值,使我们能够否定无效假设,并得出结论,在“美学”指示下,吸引力差异大于在“忠诚”指示下。

blocks.en: Performing the same analysis on the other two subjective attributes, trustworthiness and familiarity , revealed that images rated as more trustworthy also tended to receive higher rankings, although the larger p-values indicate weaker evidence for this association. In contrast, faces rated as more familiar were not significantly more likely to receive higher rankings. Furthermore, no significant difference between the two instruction conditions was found for either trustworthiness or familiarity.
blocks.zh: 对另外两个主观属性(可信赖性和熟悉性)进行同样的分析后发现,被评为更值得信赖的图像也往往得到更高的排名,尽管较大的p值表明这种关联的证据较弱. 相比之下,被评为比较熟悉的面孔并没有明显更有可能获得更高的排名. 此外,在可信赖性或熟悉性两个指令条件之间没有显著区别。

blocks.en: To summarize, our analysis suggests that humans may have a bias toward labeling a more attractive face as better quality. Our findings also suggest that this effect can be reduced, although not entirely eliminated, by asking users to rank images in terms of “image fidelity/quality”, rather than by “aesthetic preference”. We next trace how this finding propagates through leaderboards (Section 3.2 ), reward models (Section 3.3 ), and generation (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的分析表明,人类可能偏向于将一个更有吸引力的面孔贴上更好的质量标签。 我们的调查结果还表明,通过要求用户按照“形象忠贞/品质”而不是“美学偏好”对图像进行排序,这种效果是可以减轻的,但并非完全消除的。 我们接下来通过领导板(第3.2节)、奖励模式(第3.3节)和代际(第3.4节)追踪这一发现是如何传播的。

blocks.en: 3.2 Leaderboards Skew Toward Attractive Faces
blocks.zh: 3.2 指向吸引人的面板

blocks.en: Section 3.1 established that individual human raters favour attractive faces over higher-fidelity ones. We now ask whether this bias, aggregated over many pairwise comparisons, is large enough to distort the leaderboards that these comparisons are used to build.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节规定,个人的评分者偏好有吸引力的面孔,而不是高忠诚的面孔。 我们现在要问的是,通过许多双向比较汇总起来的这种偏差是否足够大,足以扭曲这些比较用来构建的领导板。

blocks.en: A popular example of an image generation leaderboard is LMArena. This platform allows a user to enter a prompt, generates two images from two separate text-to-image models, and then asks the user to pick the image they prefer. This pairwise preference data is subsequently used to calculate an Elo rating for each model. These Elo ratings determine the overall ranking of all models, where a higher score indicates a better rank.
blocks.zh: 一个图像生成领导板的流行例子是LMArena. 这个平台允许用户输入一个提示,从两个独立的文本到图像模型生成两个图像,然后请用户选择他们喜欢的图像. 这个双向偏好数据随后用于计算每个模型的Elo评级. 这些埃洛评分决定了所有模型的整体排名,其中较高的分数表明排名更好.

blocks.en: To test whether attractiveness bias systematically skews leaderboard results, we run 10,000 Elo ranking simulations using the user preference data gathered from our user study. We define two competing teams: (1) less attractive, real CelebA-HQ images, and (2) more attractive, AI-generated CelebA-HQ images. For each set of four images in our study, we select the image from each category based on the participants’ attractiveness labels. The average attractiveness labels are 34.1 and 67.9 for the real and AI-generated images, respectively. We run these simulations by randomizing the sequence of pairwise comparisons, updating the Elo ratings after each match based on the participants’ winning preference. We use initial Elo scores of 1500 and a K-factor of 64.
blocks.zh: 为了测试吸引力偏差是否系统扭曲了领导板的结果,我们运行了10,000个 Elo使用从我们的用户研究中收集的用户偏好数据进行排名模拟. 我们定义了两个相互竞争的团队:(1) 吸引力较小,真实的CelebA-HQ图像,以及(2) 更有吸引力,AI生成的CelebA-HQ图像. 对于我们研究中的每组四张图像,我们根据参与者的吸引力标签从每个类别中选择图像。 真实图像和AI生成图像的平均吸引力标签分别为34.1和67.9. 我们通过随机进行对等比较来进行这些模拟,在每次比赛后根据参赛者的胜出偏好更新Elo评分. 我们使用最初的埃洛分数1500和K因子64.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , the mean final Elo score across all simulations settled at 1438.1 for real images and 1561.9 for AI-generated images. The instructions given to users when performing the ranking change the mean final Elo scores very little. This demonstrates that attractiveness bias can easily override ground-truth realism, heavily skewing preference-based leaderboards in favour of models that generate highly attractive, albeit synthetic, human faces.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,所有模拟中的平均最终Elo得分均定在真实图像1438.1和AI生成的图像1561.9。 执行排名时给用户的指示,改变了平均最终埃洛的得分很少. 这表明,吸引力偏差很容易压倒地面真实现实主义,严重扭曲基于偏好的领导板,而倾向于产生极具吸引力、尽管是合成的人类面孔的模式。

blocks.en: 3.3 Reward Models Inherit the Bias
blocks.zh: 3.3 奖励模式继承比亚斯

blocks.en: If reward models are trained on the kind of comparison data described in Section 3.1 , we would expect them to inherit the same attractiveness bias observed in individual raters. In this section, we test this directly, examining whether the human preference models used to evaluate, guide, and finetune text-to-image models are biased towards attractive faces. We also include two reward models that are not trained on human preference data, the LAION-Aesthetics predictor [ 64 ] and CLIP [ 58 ] , as a control.
blocks.zh: 如果奖励模式得到关于第3.1节所述比较数据类型的培训,我们期望它们继承在个人评定中观察到的同样的吸引力偏差。 在本节中,我们直接测试这一点,检查用来评价,引导,微调文本到图像模型的人类偏好模型是否偏向于有吸引力的面孔. 我们还包括两个没有经过人类偏好数据培训的奖励模型,LAION-美学预测器[64]和CLIP[58],作为控制.

blocks.en: We start by experimenting on CelebA-HQ because this dataset has a binary label for attractive [ 48 ] . Specifically, we take 100 base CelebA-HQ images of resolution 256 by 256 and use a pretrained Diffusion Autoencoder [ 57 ] to change individual attributes in isolation. We use 4 randomized edit magnitudes between − 0.5 -0.5 and 0.5 0.5 . For each base image this produces 4 images for each of CelebA-HQ’s 40 attributes, for a total of 4 × 40 × 100 = 16000 4\times 40\times 100=16000 synthetic images. For an example of the image edits generated, please see Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们首先在CelebA-HQ上进行实验,因为这个数据集有一个有吸引力的二进制标签[48]. 具体来说,我们取100个基座的CelebA-HQ影像256乘256,并使用预先训练的分散自动编码器[57],以孤立地改变个人属性. 我们使用 − 0.5 - 0.5 和 0.5 之间的4 个随机编辑度。 对于每个基图像,它为每个CelebA-HQQs的40个属性产生4个图像,共计4×40×100=16,0004\times 40\times 100=16,000合成图像. 关于生成的图像编辑的例子,请见图3。

blocks.en: We then run the following reward models on, and get scores for, each image: LAION-Aesthetics predictor [ 64 ] , CLIP [ 58 ] , ImageReward [ 78 ] , PickScore, [ 38 ] , MPS, [ 82 ] , HPSv2.1 [ 77 ] , and HPSv3 [ 50 ] . For models that require a caption we use the generic text “a photo of a face”. We are then interested in the following question: Does increasing the prominence of certain facial attributes result in higher rewards?
blocks.zh: 然后我们在每个图像上运行以下奖励模型并获得分数:LAION-美学预测器[64],CLIP[58],图像奖励[78],PickScore,[38],MPS,[82],HPSv2.1[77],和HPSv3[50]. 对于需要标题的模型,我们使用通用文本“一张脸的照片”。 然后,我们对以下问题感兴趣: 增加某些面部特征的显著性是否会带来更高的回报?

blocks.en: To answer this, we calculate the correlations between the rewards given and the edit strengths. Table 2 shows which of the 40 attributes in the CelebA-HQ dataset most strongly correlate with each reward. Critically, our two non-preference control models behave differently from the five preference models: there is no discernible pattern for which attributes most strongly correlate with the LAION-Aesthetics predictor’s scores, and CLIP’s strongest correlations run through attributes associated with women (e.g. wearing earrings , heavy makeup ) rather than attractiveness. In contrast, attractive is the attribute that most strongly correlates with scores from PickScore, MPS, HPSv2.1, and HPSv3, all of which are human preference models. Importantly, many of these models are finetuned from CLIP, suggesting that this pattern only emerges from human preference alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们计算给出的奖励与编辑优势之间的关联. 表2显示CelebA-HQ数据集中的40个属性中哪些与每项奖励最密切相关。 关键是,我们两个非偏好控制模型的表现与五个偏好模型不同:没有明显的模式,其属性与LAION-美学预测器的分数关系最密切,而CLIP最强的关联是通过与女性相关的属性(如戴耳环,重妆)而不是吸引力进行的。 相比之下,吸引人的属性与PickScore,MPS,HPSv2.1和HPSv3的分数关系最密切,都是人类偏好模型. 重要的是,这些模式中有许多都从CLIP中微调出来,表明这种模式只是源于人类的偏好调整.

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows how these different captioning strategies impact the correlations between edit strength and the attractive attribute. Compared to our prior results using a constant caption, moving to LLM generated captions tends to reduce, but not eliminate the correlation. Importantly, attractiveness bias persists regardless of caption used. The one notable exception to this is ImageReward, which already has the lowest correlation, and for which an LLM based caption eliminates the bias. As discussed in Section 3.1 , ImageReward is also the reward model whose annotation instructions place the least emphasis on personal or aesthetic preference, which offers a plausible explanation for why it is comparatively less affected by attractiveness bias.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了这些不同的标题策略如何影响编辑强度与吸引人的属性之间的关联. 与使用常数标题的以往结果相比,移动到 LLM 生成的字幕往往会减少,但不会消除关联性. 重要的是,无论使用何种标题,吸引力偏见仍然存在。 其中一个显著的例外是Image Reward,它的相关性已经最低,为此基于LLM的字幕消除了偏见. 如第3.1节所述,Image Reward也是奖励模式,其注解指示最不强调个人偏好或美学偏好,这为它受吸引力偏好的影响相对较少提供了合理解释。

blocks.en: Although these results suggest that human preference models may have inherited a bias for more attractive faces, it is plausible that some attribute may produce better quality edits due to imbalances in the training data. Next, we provide additional analysis using real image datasets, where image fidelity should remain constant, thereby eliminating any possible image quality confounder.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些结果表明,人类偏好模式可能继承了对更有吸引力的面孔的偏好,但由于培训数据不平衡,某些属性可能会产生更好的质量编辑。 接下来,我们利用真实的图像数据集提供额外的分析,其中图像忠贞度应保持不变,从而消除任何可能的图像质量混淆者。

blocks.en: To analyse human preference models on real images we must consider the domains they were trained on. The majority of human preference models we consider are trained on AI generated images exclusively, making real images out-of-distribution. The one exception is HPSv3, which was trained on a mixture of both AI generated images and real images. We therefore focus primarily on this model when considering real images.
blocks.zh: 为了分析人类对真实图像的偏好模式,我们必须考虑他们接受过培训的领域。 我们认为,大多数人类偏好模型都只接受人工智能生成的图像的培训,使真实的图像脱离传播。 一个例外是HPSv3,它接受了人工智能生成的图像和真实图像的混合培训。 因此,我们在审议真实图像时主要侧重于这一模式。

blocks.en: We evaluate on two datasets: SCUT-FBP5500 [ 43 ] and CelebA-HQ [ 48 , 34 ] . Both datasets contain images of faces and accompanying labels for attractiveness. Specifically, CelebA-HQ uses binary labels and SCUT-FBP5500 uses continuous labels from 1 to 5. Evaluation uses a constant caption. Figure 5 (left) shows the HPSv3 score on real SCUT-FBP5500 images plotted against their facial beauty labels, finding a correlation coefficient of r = 0.35 r=0.35 . Figure 5 (right) shows the distribution of HPSv3 scores on real CelebA-HQ images for attractive and unattractive faces. We also get a correlation coefficient of r = 0.35 r=0.35 for this dataset. A positive correlation still existing for real images suggests that the bias toward attractive faces found previously cannot be attributed to image quality variation in synthetic images.

blocks.en: We also consider which facial attributes are most predictive of human preference scores. To do so, we perform a LASSO regression on CelebA-HQ attributes (standardized before regression), using the HPSv3 score as the target variable. By steadily increasing the regularization strength λ L \lambda_{L} , we can identify the most influential features by monitoring which attributes are retained the longest before being eliminated from the model.

blocks.en: The results in Table 3 indicate that the attractive attribute is the strongest predictor of the HPSv3 score, persisting up to a regularization strength of λ L = 0.63 \lambda_{L}=0.63 . This suggests that attractiveness carries substantial predictive information about HPSv3 scores.

blocks.en: 3.4 Preference Aligned Generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 优先一代

blocks.en: Section 3.3 establishes that facial attractiveness is both highly correlated with and highly predictive of human preference scores, but this does not yet establish a causal relationship. In this section, we therefore apply human preference models to guide the generation process itself and measure the impact of this on facial attractiveness. To measure facial attractiveness, we finetune DINOv3 [ 65 ] on CelebA-HQ labels from 0 (least) to 1 (most attractive), and use the resulting model to predict attractiveness in the following experiments (see Supplementary Material for details).
blocks.zh: 第3.3节规定,面部吸引力既与人类喜好分数高度相关,也具有高度预测性,但这尚未确立因果关系. 因此,在本节中,我们应用人类偏好模型来指导生成过程本身,并测量这对面部吸引力的影响. 为了测量面部吸引力,我们将CelebA-HQ标签上的DINOv3 [65]从0(最短)微调到1(最有吸引力),并使用由此产生的模型预测以下实验中的吸引力(详见补充材料).

blocks.en: To investigate how finetuning diffusion models based on human preferences affects the attractiveness of generated faces, we consider two approaches. First, we finetune Stable Diffusion v1.5 using AlignProp [ 56 ] , with HPSv2.1 as the reward model and prompts sampled from HPD. Second, we finetune a CelebA-HQ DDPM model [ 29 ] using DRaFT-K [ 12 ] ( K = 1 K=1 ), with PickScore as the reward model and a constant prompt strategy. Both models are trained for three epochs, and after each epoch we generate 5000 images using 50 inference steps. For Stable Diffusion v1.5, we use prompts from the CelebA-Dialog dataset [ 32 ] and a guidance scale of 5.0. Figure 7 shows the average facial attractiveness of the images generated at each stage of finetuning. For both models, attractiveness trends upwards as training progresses, suggesting that closer alignment with the human preference model leads to more attractive generated faces. The standard deviation of predicted attractiveness also decreases, although this partly reflects the predicted attractiveness saturating. The demographic distributions of generated faces provide a more direct measure of diversity (see Supplementary Material); after finetuning, generated faces become noticeably younger and more female.
blocks.zh: 为了调查基于人类喜好的微调传播模式如何影响生成的面孔的吸引力,我们考虑了两种方法。 首先,我们用 AlignProp [56] 对稳定扩散v1.5进行微调,HPSv2.1作为奖励模型,并提示从HPD中取样. 第二,我们用DRAFT-K[12](K=1K=1)来微调一个CelebA-HQ DDPM模型[29],以PickScore为奖励模型,并不断采取快速策略. 这两个模型都是为三个时代而训练的,在每个时代之后,我们使用50个推论步骤生成5000个图像. 对于Stable Difusion v1.5,我们使用来自CelebA-Dialog数据集的提示[32]和5.0的制导尺度. 图7显示了微调每个阶段生成的图像的平均面部吸引力. 对这两种模式而言,随着培训的进展,吸引力趋势会上升,这表明与人类偏好模式更加一致会导致产生更具吸引力的面孔。 预测吸引力的标准偏差也有所下降,虽然这部分反映了预测的吸引力饱和. 生成面孔的人口分布为多样性提供了更直接的衡量标准(见补充材料);经过微调后,生成面孔明显更年轻,女性也更多。

blocks.en: Finally, we consider the impact of human preference guided generation using ReNO [ 19 ] with the prompt “a photo of an unattractive face”. ReNO optimizes the initial noise in a text-to-image model using a given reward model. We use 20 optimization steps, HPSv2.1 as the reward model, and consider PixArt- α \alpha [ 9 ] , SD-Turbo [ 63 ] , and SDXL-Turbo as our T2I models. ReNO is used to optimize 5000 images for each model. As shown in Table 4 , PixArt- α \alpha and SD-Turbo are correctly able to render the target “unattractive face”, however, aligning our outputs with HPSv2.1, which should push images toward better image-text alignment, leads instead towards more attractive faces. This is also shown visually in Figure . This suggests that human preference alignment can increase facial attractiveness instead of improving text-image correspondence. If human preference alignment removes the ability to generate unattractive faces, this poses a problem for user control similar to that observed in [ 25 ] . See Supplementary Material for further analysis on different prompts and the interaction with race, gender, and age.

ReNO用于优化每个模型的5000图像. 如表4所示, PixArt- α\ alpha 和 SD- Turbo 能够正确地使目标“无赖面” , 然而, 将我们的输出与 HPSv2.1 相配合, 将图像推向更好的图像文本对齐, 反而导致更吸引人的面孔。 图中也显示了这一点。 这表明人类偏好调整可以增加面部吸引力,而不是改善文字形象对应. 如果人类偏好配对取消了生成无吸引力面部的能力,这给用户控制带来了类似于[25]中观察到的问题. 关于不同提示以及与种族、性别和年龄的相互作用的进一步分析,见补充材料。

blocks.zh: 4 缓解

blocks.en: Having established that facial attractiveness can strongly distort human preference, we now explore bias mitigation. In particular, we focus on human preference models, whose continuous scalar scores offer a valuable opportunity to apply mathematically tractable, information-theoretic debiasing techniques. We propose the following target behaviour: preference scores should depend on attractiveness only when the prompt explicitly requests it. Our evaluation prompts do not mention attractiveness, so here the preference scores S S should be independent of attractiveness A A .

Specifically, we generate 10000 images with each of Stable Diffusion v1.5 [ 61 ] , Stable Diffusion v3.5 [ 18 ] , Z-Image-Turbo [ 71 ] , LongCat-Image [ 70 ] , and FLUX.2 Klein 9B Base [ 42 ] . We then calculate scores using the human preference models most susceptible to attractiveness bias, allowing us to evaluate our debiasing approach under the strongest observed bias. The prompts used for the human preference models match those used for image generation.

blocks.en: We evaluate the effect of our debiasing approach on human preference scores. For each text-to-image model, we calibrate the β \beta parameters using 1000 images and evaluate on the remaining 9000 images, with λ = 8 ​ var ⁡ ( S ) \lambda=8\operatorname{var}(S) . As an example, Figure 8 shows the effect of our approach on HPSv3 for images generated with Stable Diffusion v3.5. The correlation between predicted facial attractiveness and human preference score is significantly reduced from 0.33 to 0.09, while maintaining a similar score range and making only minimal changes to the scores. Table 5 extends this analysis to other human preference and text-to-image models. Our approach consistently reduces the correlation between attractiveness and preference score, reducing moderate correlations to weak and weak correlations to near zero. This suggests that removal of the attractiveness bias from reward models is a tractable problem.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The attractiveness halo effect refers to a cognitive bias where attractive people are assumed to possess other positive attributes, such as kindness, intelligence, or success [ 15 , 24 ] . We find that the attractiveness halo effect also occurs when gathering human preference data for AI images, resulting in users ranking more attractive faces higher than less attractive faces. Our results suggest the bias permeates the T2I ecosystem, affecting leaderboards, preference models, and preference aligned generation alike. Our Elo simulations show that attractiveness alone can invert a face-prompt ranking, placing synthetic images above real ones and leaving leaderboards vulnerable to reward hacking by models that generate more attractive rather than better faces.
blocks.zh: 吸引力光环效应是指一种认知偏差,在这种偏差中,有吸引力的人被假定具有其他积极属性,如善良,智力,或成功[15,24]. 我们发现,在收集人工智能图像的人类偏好数据时,也会出现吸引力光环效应,导致用户排名比不太吸引人的面孔更高. 我们的结果显示,这种偏差渗透到T2I生态系统中,影响到领导板、偏好模型和偏好一致的一代。 我们的Elo模拟显示,光是吸引力就可以颠倒一个面部瞬间排列,将合成图像置于真实图像之上,使领导板易受到产生更吸引人而非更好面部的模型的黑客奖励.

blocks.en: Our findings may also have broader implications for body image since exposure to attractive faces in media has been linked to body image concerns [ 54 , 6 , 79 , 31 ] . Section 3.4 shows preference alignment both raises facial attractiveness and narrows its diversity. As AI-generated imagery proliferates on social media, preference-aligned models risk reproducing a narrow beauty ideal at scale.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果也可能对身体形象产生更广泛的影响,因为媒体对有吸引力的面孔的曝光已经与身体形象关切联系起来[54、6、79、31]。 第3.4节显示,偏好一致既提高面部吸引力,又缩小其多样性。 随着AI生成的图像在社交媒体上扩散,偏好相适应的模型有可能在规模上再现一种狭隘的美景理想.

blocks.en: Finally, Section 4 shows the bias can be removed from reward scores post-hoc, but further work is needed to prevent it appearing in preference data at all. Our results suggest wording matters: asking users to rank by image fidelity produces less biased responses than asking them to rank by aesthetic preference. Attractiveness bias also decreased the longer users took to complete the survey, although a larger sample is likely needed to prove the influence definitively. The comparatively low bias in ImageReward [ 78 ] makes its collection process of particular interest: before ranking, ImageRewardDB users write text descriptions and give numerical quality ratings, which together with its overall instructions may prime users to focus on image quality and encourage them to spend more time considering each image. Promising directions for future work therefore include experimenting with wording, imposing time limits, and using multi-dimensional annotation.
blocks.zh: 最后,第4节显示,这种偏向可以从奖励分数中去除,但还需要进一步努力防止在优惠数据中出现。 我们的结果显示措辞问题:要求用户按图像忠贞程度排列,比要求用户按美学偏好排列,产生较少偏颇的反应。 吸引力偏差还减少了用户完成调查所需的时间,尽管可能需要更大的样本才能确切证明影响。 在Image Reward [78]中相对较低的偏差使得它的收集过程特别引人关注:在排名之前,Image RewardDB用户会写出文字描述并给出数字质量评级,这与它的总体指示一起,可以引导用户关注图像质量,并鼓励他们花更多的时间考虑每个图像. 因此,未来工作的有希望的方向包括尝试措辞、规定时限和使用多维注释。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we show that attractive faces can skew human preference data for AI-generated imagery. Participants tend to rate images containing more attractive faces as better, even when image quality is equivalent or lower. We trace the impact of this bias through the text-to-image ecosystem, showing that it can skew human preference models, distort leaderboard rankings, and bias preference-aligned generation. Finally, we propose a compute-efficient approach for removing this bias from human preference scores using a mutual information minimization objective. We hope this work encourages the T2I community to refine its evaluation practices to better account for such cognitive biases.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们显示有吸引力的面孔可以扭曲人工智能生成的图像的人类偏好数据. 参与者往往将包含更吸引人的面孔的图像评为较好,即使图像质量相当或较低. 我们通过文字到图像的生态系统来追踪这种偏差的影响,显示它能够扭曲人类偏好模式,扭曲领导板排名,以及偏好对应的一代. 最后,我们建议采用一种计算效率的办法,利用相互信息最小化目标,从人类偏好分数中消除这种偏见。 我们希望这项工作鼓励T2I社区改进其评价做法,以便更好地说明这种认知偏见。

blocks.en: A.1 Societal Impact
blocks.zh: A.1 社会影响

blocks.en: The bias we identify has consequences beyond leaderboards: Section 3.4 shows that preference-aligned generation raises facial attractiveness while narrowing its diversity, shifting outputs toward younger, female, and lighter-skinned faces and removing users’ ability to generate anything else. At scale this risks reproducing a narrow beauty ideal in systems that increasingly mediate how people see faces, with documented links to body-image harm [ 27 , 6 , 79 , 30 ] . Our own methodology carries risks we state plainly: we finetune a facial attractiveness predictor and use a FairFace-trained demographic classifier, both of which are open to misuse in ranking, filtering, or profiling people, and both of which encode the judgements of particular annotator populations rather than any objective property of faces. We treat them as measurement instruments for a bias audit rather than as contributions. Finally, our mitigation is only a partial remedy. It removes the dependence of reward scores on attractiveness post-hoc but inherits the predictor’s own biases and does not stop the bias entering preference data at source, which is why we regard the finding that instruction wording measurably changes recorded bias as the more durable result.
blocks.zh: 我们所发现的偏见的后果超出了领导板:第3.4节表明,偏好相适应的一代在缩小其多样性的同时,提高了面部吸引力,将产出转向年轻、女性和较轻的皮肤,并消除了用户生成其他东西的能力。 从规模上讲,这有可能在人们如何看待面孔的系统中重现一种狭隘的美貌理想,与身体形象伤害有文件记载的联系[27、6、79、30]。 我们自己的方法带有风险,我们直言不讳地说:我们微调一个面部吸引力预测器,并使用一个FairFace训练有素的人口分类器,两者在排位、过滤或剖析人物时都容易被滥用,两者都将特定注目人群的判断而不是面部的任何客观属性编码。 我们把它们作为进行偏向性审计的衡量工具,而不是贡献。 最后,我们的缓解只是部分补救。 它消除了奖励得分对吸引力的依赖,但继承了预测者本身的偏见,并没有阻止偏见从源头输入偏好数据,因此,我们认为,指示措辞的明显改变记录了偏见是更持久的结果。

blocks.en: A.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.2 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations warrant caution when interpreting our findings. First, in the user study, participants rated attractiveness after ranking the same faces, so their attractiveness ratings may have been influenced by their earlier preferences. Furthermore, we assume that real photographs are generally of higher image quality than AI-generated images, however, if a real image is especially blurred (as a small number of CelebA image are) or corrupted with noise, this may not always hold true. Directly matching image quality across individual real and generated images is challenging, as common metrics such as FID and IS are primarily designed for evaluating distributions of images rather than the quality of individual images. Comparing real photographs with generated images therefore provides a useful, albeit imperfect, way to investigate whether attractiveness influences preferences when image sources differ.
blocks.zh: 在解释我们的调查结果时,有若干限制值得谨慎。 首先,在用户研究中,参与者在对相同的面孔进行排名后对吸引力进行评分,因此他们的吸引力评级可能受到了他们早期偏好的影响. 此外,我们假设真实的照片通常比AI生成的图像具有更高的图像质量,但是,如果真实的图像特别模糊(如少数CelebA图像是)或被噪音腐蚀,这可能并不总是真实的. 直接匹配单个真实和生成的图像的图像质量具有挑战性,因为FID和IS等通用的度量标准主要是为了评价图像的分布,而不是单个图像的质量. 因此,将真实的照片与生成的图像进行比较,提供了一种有用、尽管不尽人意的办法来调查在图像来源不同时吸引力是否影响偏好。

blocks.en: Similarly, our Elo experiment uses selected comparisons between less attractive real faces and more attractive generated faces to illustrate how attractiveness bias could affect leaderboard rankings. It represents a constructed scenario rather than a direct measurement of distortion in existing leaderboards. The results should therefore be interpreted as demonstrating a potential vulnerability rather than quantifying the extent of leaderboard distortion in practice.
blocks.zh: 同样,我们的Elo实验利用一些比较,在不太吸引人的真实面孔和较吸引人生成的面孔之间进行比较,以说明吸引力偏差会如何影响领板排名. 它代表一种构建的情景,而不是直接衡量现有领导板的扭曲情况。 因此,结果应被解释为表明潜在的脆弱性,而不是量化实际领导板扭曲的程度。

blocks.en: It is also important to note that the DiffAE editing procedure may inadvertently alter attributes correlated with attractiveness, as well as other aspects of image appearance and quality. Although the example in Figure 3 (in the main body of the paper) suggest that the intended edits can be achieved without severe visible entanglement, we cannot guarantee that attractiveness is the only property that changes. This means that the attribute-editing experiments cannot independently establish that attractiveness alone accounts for the observed preference differences. However, the real-image experiments provide complementary evidence without relying on DiffAE-generated edits, reducing our dependence on any single experimental approach.
blocks.zh: 还必须指出,DiffAE编辑程序可能会无意中改变与吸引力相关的属性,以及图像外观和质量的其他方面. 虽然图3(在论文正文中)中的例子表明,在不出现严重可见缠绕的情况下,可以实现预期的编辑,但我们无法保证吸引力是改变的唯一属性. 这意味着属性编辑实验不能独立地确定,仅凭吸引力就可以说明观察到的偏好差异. 然而,真象实验在不依赖DiffAE生成的编辑的情况下提供了补充证据,降低了我们对任何单一实验方法的依赖.

blocks.en: Taken together, our experiments provide converging evidence that facial attractiveness is associated with human preferences for text-to-image outputs and may influence reward-model scores and leaderboard rankings, but no individual experiment conclusively isolates attractiveness from all potential confounding factors. Further work using quality-matched comparisons, more exact text-to-image leaderboard setups, and broader sampling of images and participants would help establish the magnitude of these effects.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的实验提供了一致的证据,表明面部吸引力与人类对文字到图像输出的偏好有关,并可能影响奖励模式的分数和领导板排名,但没有任何个别实验最终将吸引力与所有潜在的困惑因素隔离开来。 进一步利用质量匹配的比较、更精确的文字到图像领导板设置以及更广泛的图像取样和参与者,将有助于确定这些影响的程度。

blocks.en: B.1 Facial Attractiveness Predictor
blocks.zh: B.1 表面吸引力

blocks.en: In the main body of text we use a checkpoint finetuned from DINOv3 [ 65 ] to predict facial attractiveness. Specifically, we use the dinov3-vits16-pretrain-lvd1689m checkpoint as our starting point. We then finetune the checkpoint on cropped and aligned facial images from the CelebA [ 48 ] and SCUT-FBP5500 [ 43 ] datasets. Each dataset has its own prediction head, with the binary labels from CelebA learned using binary cross entropy loss and the continuous labels from SCUT-FBP5500 learned using mean squared error loss. Both label sets are direct attractiveness ratings of real photographs, collected independently of any AI-generated image or preference-comparison task. We train for 20 epochs using the AdamW optimizer [ 37 ] in PyTorch with a learning rate of 1e-5 for the backbone and a learning rate of 1e-3 for the prediction heads. Other optimizer parameters are set to PyTorch defaults: beta values are (0.9, 0.999) and weight decay is 0.01. The final checkpoint is taken from the epoch with the lowest total validation loss (90/10 training/validation split is used for both datasets). Figure 9 shows the training and validation losses over the 20 epochs. The model converges quickly, reaching its peak validation loss after the second epoch. On the CelebA validation split, the model reaches 81% accuracy on binary attractiveness prediction.
blocks.zh: 在正文中,我们使用从DINOv3[65]微调的检查点来预测面部吸引力. 具体来说,我们使用Dinov3 -vits16 -pretrain -lvd1689m检查站作为起点. 然后根据来自CelebA [48] 和SCUT-FBP5500 [43] 数据集的剪切和对齐的面部图像对检查点进行微调. 每个数据集都有自己的预测头,来自CelebA的二进制标签是使用二进制交叉 en损学的,而来自SCUT-FBP5500的连续标签是使用平均平方误损学的. 这两个标签集都是真实照片的直接吸引力评级,收集时独立于任何AI生成的图像或偏好对比任务. 我们在PyTorch使用AdamW优化器[37]为20个时代进行训练,骨干学习率为1e-5,预测头的学习率为1e-3。 其他优化参数设定为PyTorch默认值:β值为(0.9,0.999),重量衰减为0.01. 最终检查点取自总验证损失最低的时代(两个数据集都使用90/10训练/验证分机)。 图9显示20个世纪的培训和鉴定损失。 模型迅速汇合,在第二个纪元后达到高峰验证损失. 在CelebA验证分裂上,模型在二进制吸引力预测上达到了81%的精度.

blocks.en: B.2 ReNO Experiments
blocks.zh: B.2 ReNO实验

blocks.en: In this section we provide further analysis on ReNO-based [ 19 ] guided generation using HPSv2.1 [ 77 ] . As in the main body of the text we use PixArt- α \alpha [ 9 ] as the base text-to-image model. Specifically, we run ReNO for 50 steps using 3 distinct prompts: ”a photo of an unattractive face”, ”a photo of a face”, and ”a photo of an attractive face”. We apply ReNO to 100 images for each prompt. In Figure 10 we provide the mean predicted beauty (SCUT-FBP5500 prediction head used) for images across all 50 steps. We can see that preference alignment boosts the attractiveness of all images regardless of the prompt used. We again emphasize how this could limit user control because whatever prompt is used, the faces generated will almost entirely appear as very attractive. Through preference alignment, the ability to generate unattractive faces is effectively removed.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们用HPSv2.1[77]进一步分析基于RENO的[19]制导生成。 和文本的正文一样,我们使用 PixArt-α\alpha [9] 作为基本文本对图像模型. 具体地说,我们用三个不同的提示来运行ReNO50步:“一张不吸引人的脸的照片”、“一张脸的照片”和“一张吸引人的脸的照片”。 我们把ReNO应用到每个提示的100个图像上. 在图10中,我们提供了所有50个步骤的图像的平均预测美(使用的SCUT-FBP5500预测头). 我们可以看到,无论使用何种迅速,偏好一致都会增强所有图像的吸引力。 我们再次强调,这如何能够限制用户的控制,因为无论使用何种提示,生成的面孔几乎都显得非常有吸引力。 通过偏好对齐,有效消除了产生无吸引力面容的能力.

blocks.en: We also provide analysis on how the optimization of these 300 images alters the age, race, and gender of the faces depicted. To measure this we use a pretrained classifier 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/TimmaJ/age-gender-race-prediction trained on FairFace [ 33 ] to predict the age, race, and gender of face before and after preference alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们还分析了这300幅图像的优化如何改变所描绘的面孔的年龄、种族和性别。 为了衡量这一点,我们使用经过预先训练的分类器2 2 https://huggingface.co/TimmaJ/age-gender-race-presidency在FairFace[33]上受过训练,以预测在优惠调整前后的年龄、种族和性别。

blocks.en: According to our classifier, all faces generated before and after generation were white. Figure 11 shows confusion matrices describing how both age and gender change during optimization. The majority of faces remain the same gender as when they started, however, out of the faces that do change, 61 change from male to female and only 3 change from female to male. Similarly, most faces stay in the same age category before and after optimization, but nearly all faces that changes age are changed to look younger, with an especially large focus on the 16-24 years old category. This suggests that HPSv2.1 shows a preference for young female faces.
blocks.zh: 根据我们的分类者,所有世代前后产生的面孔都是白色的. 图11显示了在优化期间年龄和性别变化的混乱矩阵。 然而,大多数面孔与开始时的性别相同,从确实改变的面孔中,有61个从男性改为女性,只有3个从女性改为男性。 同样,大多数面孔在优化前后都保留在同一年龄类别,但几乎所有改变年龄的面孔都改为看起来更年轻,尤其主要关注16-24岁的类别. 这表明HPSv2.1显示出对年轻女性面孔的偏好.

blocks.zh: 所有ReNO实验均使用其官方GitHub repo中提供的默认超参数,除非另有说明.

blocks.en: B.3 Preference Finetuning Experiments
blocks.zh: B.3 首选精细化实验

blocks.en: In the main body of the text we also use DRaFT [ 12 ] to finetune a CelebA DDPM model [ 29 ] using rewards from PickScore [ 38 ] . We measure how finetuning changes the demographics of the face using a FairFace trained classifier. We generate 1000 images with the same random seeds, using the model weights pre- and post-finetuning. The confusion matrices in Figure 12 show how finetuning with PickScore impacts age, gender, and race. Similarly to Figure 11 , we note that faces tend to be feminized and made younger. The base models shows more diversity in terms of race, but it is common for non-white to be changed into white faces.
blocks.zh: 在正文中,我们也使用DRAFT[12]来微调一个CelebA DDPM模型[29],使用PickScore[38]的奖励. 我们用一个训练有素的FairFace分类器来测量如何微调面部人口结构。 我们用相同的随机种子生成1000张图像, 使用模型的分量 预和后调整。 图12中的混淆矩阵显示,如何调整与PickScore的影响年龄、性别和种族。 与图11类似,我们注意到,面孔往往女性化,变年轻。 基础模型在种族方面表现出更多的多样性,但非白种人通常会被改变为白色面孔.

blocks.en: We also show qualitative results from our AlignProp and DRaFT finetuning experiment in Figures 13 and 14 , respectively. We can see that both finetuning approaches result in a combination of different effects including the reduction of artifacts, the changing of demographics, and an increase in facial attractiveness.
blocks.zh: 我们还在图13和图14中分别显示我国的AlignProp和DRAFT微调实验的质量结果。 我们可以看到,两种微调方法都导致不同效果的结合,包括减少文物,改变人口结构,增加面部吸引力.

blocks.en: B.4 GPT-Image-2 Stable Diffusion Comparison
blocks.zh: B.4 GPT-图像-2 稳定扩散比较

blocks.en: Figure 1 in the main body of the paper includes two images, one generated by Stable Diffusion v1.5 and one generated by GPT-Image-2. The first image was generated using Stable Diffusion v1.5 using the prompt “a photo of an attractive face”. To maintain the structure of this image, but change the facial attractiveness, we then blurred this image and gave it to GPT-Image-2 with the following prompt: “Unblur this image according to the following prompt. “a photo of an unattractive face” ”. We then evaluated both images using reward models which all received a neutral prompt “a photo of a face”.
blocks.zh: 论文正文中的图1包括两个图像,一个由稳定扩散v1.5生成,另一个由GPT-Image-2生成. 第一个图像是使用Stable Difusion v1.5生成的,使用了“一张有吸引力的脸的照片”。 为了保持这个图像的结构,但改变面部吸引力,我们随后模糊了这个图像,并把它交给了GPT-Image-2,其提示如下: “根据下面的提示解开这个图像。 “一张无吸引力的脸的照片”。 然后,我们利用奖励模型评估了这两幅图像,这些模型都收到了中立的“一张一张脸的照片”。

blocks.en: For this illustrative example we make the assumption that the image produced by GPT-Image-2 is of better quality than the image produced by Stable Diffusion v1.5. We believe this assumption is well founded due to GPT-Image-2 being significantly more modern than Stable Diffusion v1.5. In addition, visual inspection of the Stable Diffusion image reveals clear artifacts such as misshapen irises in the eyes, unnatural looking teeth, and overly smoothed skin. In comparison, the image produced by GPT-Image-2 contains no obvious artifacts.
blocks.zh: 对于这个说明性的例子,我们假设,GPT-Image-2产生的图像质量优于Stable Difusion v1.5产生的图像. 我们相信这个假设是有充分根据的,因为GPT-Image-2的现代化程度大大高于稳定传播v1.5. 此外,对稳定扩散图像的目视检查显示,有清晰的文物,如眼部的Misshapen irises、外观不自然的牙齿和皮肤过于平滑。 相比之下,GPT-Image-2制作的图像中并没有明显的文物.

blocks.en: B.6 Additional Mitigation Details
blocks.zh: B.6 额外的缓解细节

blocks.en: In this section, we provide additional analysis on our information theoretic strategy for mitigation of attractiveness bias in human preference reward models.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进一步分析了我们的信息理论战略,以减少人类偏好奖励模式中的吸引力偏见。

blocks.en: In particular, we seek to determine if scores can still be of use once debiasing has been done. To test this we take the lowest and highest scoring 5k images for each T2I model and each reward model examined in Section 4. For each of these subsets we calculate the FID against the CelebA-Dialog dataset. We then apply our debiasing approach in order to adjust these scores and recalculate the FID of the bottom and top 5k images. Note that the same 10k images are used for each T2I model before and after adjustment; however, some images move between the two 5k subsets.
blocks.zh: 特别是,我们力求确定,一旦解禁,分数是否仍然有用。 为了测试这一点,我们为每个T2I模型以及第4节所检查的每个奖励模型取最低和最高的5k图像。 对于每一个子集,我们对照CelebA-Dialog数据集计算FID. 然后,我们应用我们的解析方法来调整这些分数,并重新计算底部和前5k图像的FID. 注意调整前后每个T2I模型都使用相同的10k图像;然而,一些图像在两个5k子集之间移动.

blocks.en: Table 6 shows the impact of our mutual information based correction on the FID of the 5k image subsets. We first note that reward model scores do not reliably track FID for the dataset considered (6 out of 20 of the worse scoring 5k image subsets actually get better FID scores). Importantly, however, our adjustment has very little impact on FID with the average change before and after adjustment being 0.19 (with the average absolute change is 0.69). At the same time, our correction reduces the difference in mean predicted attractiveness between the top and bottom subsets by 71.8% (averaged across all models). These results suggest that removing the attractiveness signal does not remove the aspects of image quality that FID captures.
blocks.zh: 表6显示我们基于5k图像子集的FID修正的相互信息的影响。 我们首先指出,奖励模式的分数无法可靠地跟踪所考虑的数据集的FID(在最差的5k图像子集的20个中,有6个实际得到更好的FID分数)。 然而,重要的是,我们的调整对FID的影响很小,调整前后的平均变化为0.19(平均绝对变化为0.69)。 与此同时,我们的校正降低了上下子集之间平均预测吸引力的差值71.8%(在所有模型中平均). 这些结果表明,去除吸引力信号并不能消除FID捕捉到的图像质量方面.

blocks.en: We consider the technical reports and blog posts accompanying each of these models’ releases. Models that have undergone some sort of preference alignment include: Cosmos3-Super-Text2Image (Agentic), Cosmos3-Super-Text2Image, hunyuan-image-3.0, qwen-image-2512, hidream-o1-image, krea-2-turbo, z-image-turbo, qwen-image-prompt-extend, qwen-image, and glm-image. Models for which we could not discern from the documentation if any preference alignment had taken place include: ideogram-4.0-quality, flux-2-dev, flux-2-klein-9b, flux-2-klein-4b, and flux-1-dev-fp8.
